  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pubchem_cid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enriched,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pubchem_cid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as to_enrich
FROM molecules;
